title: Disclaimer | Unique Visa Services
description: Unique Visa Services is a private advisory service, not affiliated with the Home Office or any government.
body: Unique Visa Services Ltd is a private immigration and visa advisory service. We are not affiliated with the Home Office, UK Visas and Immigration, or any foreign government or embassy.
You can apply for any visa directly through the official government website. Our professional fees are charged in addition to any government or consular fees.
Information on this website is general guidance and not advice for your individual circumstances. Immigration rules change frequently; contact us for advice on your situation.
